notes: Only City + Locality units with at least the selected number of restaurants are shown (primary threshold 30; sensitivity 20 and 50).
Coverage is concentrated in New Delhi: at the primary threshold 74 of 98 units are in New Delhi, 12 in Gurgaon, 11 in Noida, 1 in Faridabad and 0 in Ghaziabad.
Rating statistics are shown only for units with at least 20 rated restaurants (82 of 98 units at the primary threshold).
City benchmarks cover all restaurants in the city; NCR benchmarks cover all 7,947 NCR restaurants (5,808 rated).
Ranks are indicative: between 4 and 9 of each top-10 list are shared between the 30- and 20-restaurant thresholds.
Locality values bundle footfall, demographics, rents and restaurant mix; they are not effects of location.
No coordinates are used: 499 listings carry (0,0) placeholder coordinates, so no map is drawn.
